text: So sorry to trouble you at this hour, I expect you've got far more serious calls than mine. I'm looking after my granddaughter Ellie, she's 9. Her temperature is 39.8, I think, if I'm reading this new thermometer right. She hasn't been to the toilet for a poo in three days, I'm fairly sure, and she's quite cross and grumpy about it. Her cheeks are very red but I believe that's from playing out in that cold wind this afternoon, they went like that while she was outside. She's wide awake, chatting away to me and watching her programme, perfectly with it. I'm probably worrying over nothing. Apologies again.
